newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices turn narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices turn narrowly mixed.

text.p: U.S. crude futures prices were narrowly mixed in the ACCESS overnight market, traders said, with little news or technical direction to sway values.
"It could move in either direction. There's no news to push it," one trader said.
June crude oil eased five cents a gallon to $19.86 a barrel Monday, amid volume of 195 lots traded and 293 overall, a light number of lots traded.
Key barriers for the crude market to move through were pegged at $19.65 on the low end, and $20.25 on the high end.
Both levels were based on moving day averages, which analysts use to chart the history of prices.
After-hours, NYMEX May heating oil edged seven points to 56.60 cents with trader shrugging off the rise because volume was extremely light at 47 lots in the May contract.
June unleaded gasoline futures fell 0.14 cents a gallon to 62.20, with 23 lots changing hands.
